title: Radial clock-face day planner
blurb: Live HTML event strips curve round a 24h or 12h WebGL 2 clock dial while native time inputs stay clickable in a dock via updateElementGeometry(). Dragging ring handles snaps to 15-minute blocks.
question: Can live HTML event cards and native <input type="time"> controls drive a radial 24-hour and 12-hour clock planner rendered in WebGL 2, curving event labels along polar ring wedges while projecting the active event's time inputs onto a clickable dock via updateElementGeometry()?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas uploads the event strips, dial numerals and inspector dock via texElementSubImage2D(), warps each block along a polar donut wedge, maps ring handle drags back to 15-minute snapped <input type="time"> values, and syncs the dock and tangent wedge hotspots with updateElementGeometry().
